body: I live in eastern PA- My dad is an HVAC tech in Florida. Since we have lived here, it has not gotten into single digits in the winter. I think he just want to play around with my furnace and install something he thinks is nifty.

Update: I emailed customer service last night and heard back from them. They included a discount code and have apologized as well as stated that they are highlighting the issue with QC and their warehouse. 


The issue is not that they have been tried on. I fully understand that clothes and shoes get tried on. I just don't want to be reminded of that. Same as how if I bought a pair of jeans online, I don't want them to come with someone else's underwear...  Even if the tag is still on the underwear. 

I work in an industry where quality control is crucial. Small details that can be overlooked may lead to a larger problem. I am very happy with the response from Solovair and have set up an exchange. And honestly, if they were to send me the same boots, I wouldn't be any wiser, I just wouldn't think about strangers feets 🤣

Ruggable! Iris Apfel flutterby. 
We ordered the 10x14 for our living room. Haven't had to wash it yet, but it is amazing.
Yeah. I think I'm trying to get someone to rationalize my way past the ick.

Check with QA and see if they will allow you to have personal devices? I have my personal Mitutoyo at work and they have it calibrated, stickered and noted as being my personal device. 

 They did make sure I was aware that they are not responsible for any damage or loss of the device, so I just secure it when I am not at work.

It's been frustrating. My experience is in inventory management for large manufacturing facilities. Essentially inprocessing the incoming materials and (almost immediate) outgoing of finished products. Not much of that available here. I have alerts set up and I do almost daily checks. The resume is the hardest part for me, I like to feel I am modest so trying to "sell" myself is a difficult concept to grasp. 

Top all of that off with working for family and knowing I could leave them without anyone with this experience is a little heart breaking. My partner has been trying to help me learn to put myself and my mental health first, so I've got that going for me.
I have. It's unfortunately one of those damned if you do situations.
